caveats: Archive architectural study from the functional booklet and a historical relative-height section; not a current survey.
Partial major-wall interiors. Thin line-only partitions, decoration and services remain incomplete; only source-supported details are modelled.
Storey alignment is inferred, with 0.398 m observed cross-plan discrepancy. Absolute datum and true north unresolved.
Opening heads/glazing, stairs and roof treatment are inferred study geometry, not verified architectural details.
Explicit complete-product membership and rigid placements are registered for modelled window, door and column families; the inventory is not a census of the real building.

Reviewed regularized wall openings have host/filling semantics. Special legacy apertures without reviewed host mapping remain unhosted. No closed IfcSpace volumes or surveyed map conversion are asserted.
Portineria uses distinct pt0/pt1/pt2 storeys and buildingId properties within the shared reference-export container; separate surveyed site/building placement is not established.

Audit 2026-10-09: stair treads are grouped into flight elements (IfcStairFlight) and railing pieces into run elements (IfcRailing); retired per-piece product ids are listed in research/derived/audit-registry-migration-v013.json. Site-scope products are contained in the reserved site storey (IfcSite). Derived openings describe product bounds, not surveyed apertures.
